create.notes_placeholder: Optional context for this validation run.

weight.samples_hint: One row per capsule/tablet weighed. Press Enter to add the next sample.

disintegration.title: Disintegration test
disintegration.samples_hint: One row per capsule/tablet tested — per USP <701>, typically 6 units.

wizard.targets_help: These are the pass/fail criteria for this batch. Define them before recording any samples so the outcome can't be gamed after the fact.
wizard.missing_targets_hint: Fill every target field on each step before starting the validation.
wizard.missing_samples_hint: Record samples for weight + disintegration and fill the organoleptic actuals (colour / taste / odour + pass) before you can mark this validation as passed.
